    global edge_idx, head, next_edge, to_node, capacity, cost_edge
    next_edge[edge_idx] = head[u]
    to_node[edge_idx] = v
    capacity[edge_idx] = cap
    cost_edge[edge_idx] = cst
    head[u] = edge_idx
    edge_idx += 1

def spfa():

        dist[i] = INF
        in_queue[i] = False
    q = deque()
    q.append(s)
    in_queue[s] = True
    dist[s] = 0
    flow[s] = float('inf')
    parent[t] = -1
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        in_queue[u] = False
        i = head[u]
        while i != 0:
            v = to_node[i]
            if capacity[i] > 0 and dist[v] > dist[u] + cost_edge[i]:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + cost_edge[i]
                parent[v] = u
                last_edge[v] = i
                flow[v] = min(flow[u], capacity[i])
                if not in_queue[v]:
                    in_queue[v] = True
                    q.append(v)
            i = next_edge[i]
    return parent[t] != -1

    total_flow = 0
    total_cost = 0
    while spfa():

        while current != s:

            capacity[last_edge[current] ^ 1] += flow[t]
            current = parent[current]
